final: WITH filtered AS (SELECT cr.raceId, cr.points FROM constructorResults cr WHERE cr.points > 1.0), race_avgs AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(f.points) as per_race_avg, COUNT(*) as result_count FROM filtered f JOIN races r ON f.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), race_name_avgs AS (SELECT name, AVG(per_race_avg) as race_name_avg FROM race_avgs GROUP BY name) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.name, ra.per_race_avg, ra.result_count, ra.per_race_avg / rna.race_name_avg as ratio FROM race_avgs ra JOIN race_name_avgs rna ON ra.name = rna.name ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
